description: Ballerina HTTP service exposing the store's product catalog, cart, checkout, order, and admin-management endpoints behind the platform's API gateway. Owns all business data (products, inventory, carts, orders, payments) in ceramics-db, calls Stripe to capture card payments, and sends the order-confirmation email via the chosen email provider. Validates Thunder-issued bearer tokens to distinguish guest, signed-in Shopper, and Store Admin callers; does not render any UI.
